card.text: Explore Mithra in 3D with its published radar shape model.

introduction.text: Mithra is a strongly bifurcated near-Earth asteroid reconstructed from radar observations in 2000. This prograde model is one of two comparably fitting spin solutions. Radar constrained less than half the surface; the unseen hemisphere depends on model assumptions. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Radar height relative to an 845 m sphere. Less than half was observed; the far side depends on assumptions.
